q: How do I prepare for a high-altitude climb?
a: Build aerobic endurance and strength over months, gain relevant mountain experience on smaller peaks, and plan staged acclimatization.
Acute mountain sickness can cause headache, nausea and fatigue. Worsening symptoms mean descend and seek medical help; HAPE and HACE are life-threatening.
Most major peaks require permits or registration (e.g. Denali via the US National Park Service). Requirements and fees change; always confirm with the official authority.

q: What are the costs and cancellation terms?
